verdict.rationale: Porkbun holds account, domain and identity data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data is kept out of AI model training; the axis applies. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, training-exclusion policy, or data-use commitment. The community note about ID-verification data being deleted after verification concerns a different privacy practice, not AI training, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
